# Steam Locomotive Insurance

## About
Steam Locomotive Insurance (steamlocomotiveinsurance.com) is a specialty insurance agency focused on heritage steam railroad operators — steam excursion railroads, dinner and tourist steam trains, railroad museums running steam, and steam locomotive restoration shops. A division of Contractors Choice Agency, NPN #8608479, licensed in all 50 states since 2005.

## Services
- General Liability Insurance: Third-party bodily injury and property damage across the depot, platforms, grounds, and public operations.
- Railroad Liability (FELA) Insurance: The fault-based federal Federal Employers' Liability Act exposure for railroad employees — the coverage standard no-fault workers comp does not address.
- Passenger Liability Insurance: Bodily injury to fare-paying passengers riding excursion, dinner, and tourist trains — boarding, alighting, coaches, and open-air cars.
- Rolling Stock & Equipment Insurance: Physical damage to locomotives, coaches, and rolling stock — derailment, collision, fire, and in-transit/interchange — on an agreed-value basis for irreplaceable heritage equipment.
- Boiler & Machinery Insurance: Sudden boiler failure and mechanical/electrical breakdown (equipment breakdown), including resulting damage and lost income; includes jurisdictional boiler inspections.
- Commercial Property Insurance: Depot, roundhouse, restoration shop, museum buildings, track and lineside structures, and contents against fire, storm, and theft; includes business income.
- Workers Compensation Insurance: Medical bills and lost wages for shop, station, and grounds staff, coordinated with FELA railroad liability for covered crews.

## Target Audience
Heritage steam excursion railroads, dinner and tourist steam trains, railroad museums operating steam, and steam locomotive restoration shops.
